arguments.nl_query: List the 10 most recent tasks (of any task label) with their runner (username), status, and start timestamp. Include the first output file name if one exists. Order by start desc.

examples.nl_query: How many nodes of each label do we have?
examples.cypher:
MATCH (n)
UNWIND labels(n) AS lbl
RETURN lbl AS label, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC

MATCH (a)-[r]->(b)
WITH labels(a)[0] AS from, type(r) AS rel, labels(b)[0] AS to
RETURN DISTINCT from, rel, to
ORDER BY from, rel, to
